title: Character Merchandising
abstracted_dimensions: character merchandising is framed as authorized adaptation or secondary use of a character across goods or services
name image appearance and other essential personality features are identified as character-recognition carriers
audience affinity with a character is distinguished from the physical product carrying that character
authorization and rights arrangements are part of the merchandising context rather than an optional afterthought
limitations: the report is an older international overview and is not a controlled illustration-recognition experiment
its legal discussion cannot establish clearance in any particular jurisdiction or platform
it does not prescribe which visual anchors must be retained for any specific original character
commercial affinity is a conceptual relationship here and not evidence that a proposed design will sell
reuse_note: Only the abstract need to preserve original character-recognition features across authorized adaptations informed this matrix; no character, product, artwork, source wording, or protected design is reused.

mechanisms.statement: define a bounded identity-anchor ledger before changing scale proportion pose or substrate
retain a recognizable silhouette and one internal landmark constellation while simplifying surface detail
remove microtexture before removing action expression or signature object relationships needed for recognition
preview every adaptation at its actual smallest deployment size rather than judging only the master canvas
vary message pose and expression while keeping a stable subset of identity anchors across the set
map super-deformed proportion changes consistently so head torso limb and accessory shifts remain systematic
derive main image thumbnail sticker and merchandise variants from one traceable master identity specification
treat rights provenance as an input gate separate from visual identity preservation

illustration_evidence_definitions.merch_anchor_silhouette_match: The master, SD, sticker, and merchandise variants retain the same deliberately selected outer-contour anchors when shown as flat black shapes.
illustration_evidence_definitions.merch_face_landmark_constellation: At least two original internal landmarks keep their relative placement after simplification without copying any third-party character design.
illustration_evidence_definitions.merch_signature_object_relation: An original object remains connected to the character through the same carrying, wearing, handling, or spatial relation instead of appearing as an unrelated icon.
illustration_evidence_definitions.merch_palette_value_anchor: A small original value-and-color relationship survives conversion while hue alone is never treated as sufficient identity proof.
illustration_evidence_definitions.merch_scale_legibility_triptych: The same adaptation is inspected at master size, ordinary use size, and smallest platform size with the intended expression and action still distinguishable.
illustration_evidence_definitions.merch_expression_family_continuity: Several expression or message poses visibly differ in action while a stable subset of original identity anchors remains unchanged.
illustration_evidence_definitions.merch_sd_proportion_mapping: A side-by-side construction overlay shows that every SD variant follows one declared head, torso, limb, and accessory proportion mapping.
illustration_evidence_definitions.merch_master_output_trace: Each output can be traced to the same original master specification through a variant identifier and a short list of retained and intentionally changed anchors.

candidate_definitions.merch_face_landmark_constellation: At least two original internal landmarks keep their relative placement after simplification without copying any third-party character design.

candidate_definitions.merch_master_output_trace: Each output can be traced to the same original master specification through a variant identifier and a short list of retained and intentionally changed anchors.
candidate_definitions.identity_anchor_ledger: A pre-adaptation list of three to five original silhouette, landmark, object-relation, or value anchors selected for continuity.
candidate_definitions.thumbnail_readability_check: A required inspection of expression, action, and anchor recognition at the smallest intended display size.
candidate_definitions.sd_proportion_map: A declared systematic mapping from the original anatomy and accessories to one super-deformed proportion system.
candidate_definitions.expression_variant_invariant: A rule that changes communicative pose and expression while preserving a named subset of original identity anchors.
candidate_definitions.format_crop_safe_zone: A per-format region in which essential face, gesture, silhouette, and object-relation evidence must remain visible.
candidate_definitions.merch_master_continuity: A trace linking every approved output variant to one original master identity specification and change record.
candidate_definitions.gesture_message_adaptation: A format-aware action or expression chosen for conversational use without replacing the character with text alone.
candidate_definitions.rights_provenance_gate: A non-legal metadata gate recording that source ownership, license, permission, or public-domain basis was supplied before adaptation.

compatibility: combine the identity-anchor ledger with format-specific crop and scale checks
allow large pose and expression variation when at least two declared identity anchors remain legible
pair an SD proportion map with a non-SD master so exaggeration can be checked as a deliberate transformation
use a signature object only when its relationship to the original character is stable and rights-cleared
keep dialogue text optional so the character action remains understandable without the caption
conflicts: do not preserve identity through color alone when silhouette landmarks and object relationships all change
do not stack every costume detail into a tiny sticker until the expression and action disappear
do not use a full-height pose in a format where the face and gesture become unreadable
do not treat a licensed physical substrate as permission to copy an unrelated protected character design
do not let automatic cropping remove the only identity anchor or message-bearing gesture
counterexamples: a recolored generic chibi with no stable silhouette landmark or object relationship
forty nearly identical facial crops whose captions carry all communicative meaning
a detailed master that becomes an indistinct vertical sliver at chat-tab size
a mascot thumbnail that is unrelated to the sticker set it represents
a claimed SD variant whose proportions and accessory placement change randomly between poses
boundaries: no named franchise character logo costume silhouette prop constellation or catchphrase is collected as a reusable candidate
rights provenance is required metadata but is not a legal clearance opinion
platform dimensions are format evidence and must not be generalized as universal merchandise standards
small-scale legibility does not justify offensive stereotyped or culturally reductive simplification
all character designs remain original user-owned public-domain or demonstrably licensed inputs
no sales conversion attachment or recognizability claim is made without direct evaluation
format_implications: maintain separate master sticker main-image and tab-thumbnail previews because each has a different scale and crop burden
test icon-like outputs at 18 by 18 and 72 by 72 reference sizes as a distinctiveness stress test rather than a universal export requirement
for chat stickers prioritize readable action expression and transparent silhouette over full-body detail density
for physical merchandise record substrate edge bleed seam and occlusion zones before selecting retained anchors
viewer_implications: a returning viewer should encounter a stable anchor constellation before noticing format-specific exaggeration
a first-time viewer should still understand the sticker action without knowing the character lore
set variety should come from changed communicative acts rather than from erasing character continuity
recognition affinity and purchase intent remain separate outcomes and neither is inferred from a prompt audit

title: Guidelines for Submitting Unicode Emoji Proposals
abstracted_dimensions: proposal images are examined at both 18 by 18 and 72 by 72 pixels
distinctiveness requires a recognizable visual paradigm at typical mobile display size
exact vendor rendering is not standardized and representations may vary by platform
text-heavy concepts create localization and recognition problems
limitations: emoji encode general concepts rather than preserving a proprietary character identity
selection rules for a text standard are not merchandise sales or character-design criteria
the listed pixel sizes are stress-test references and not universal sticker export dimensions
the guideline does not measure viewer attachment to a character
reuse_note: Only small-scale preview, distinctiveness, and representation-variation principles were abstracted; no emoji glyph, proposal image, vendor artwork, or exact protected symbol is reused.

title: LINE Creators Market Sticker Creation Guidelines
abstracted_dimensions: the platform distinguishes main image sticker images and chat thumbnail icon with separate dimensions
sticker artwork is automatically resized and requires transparent backgrounds and bounded margins
recommended stickers use readily understandable expressions messages and illustrations
poor visibility full-height narrow figures and low-variety sets are specifically discouraged
limitations: the rules apply to one platform and may change
approval criteria do not prove character identity recognition or commercial success
platform moderation and rights requirements are not a substitute for jurisdiction-specific advice
text guidance does not establish universal cross-language equivalence
reuse_note: Only format roles, visibility, resize, margin, and conversational-legibility constraints were abstracted; no platform character, sample sticker, logo, or source wording is reused.

title: Art Direction: Graphic Design is Key
abstracted_dimensions: a game's visual signature is formed through coordinated typography iconography logo color and graphic elements
the same identity system can be executed across interface print key art and motion rather than copied unchanged
first impressions and marketplace recognition are explicit art-direction concerns
graphic design is treated as part of art direction instead of a promotional layer added after production
limitations: the conference session is expert practice evidence rather than a controlled audience experiment
one production framework does not establish a universal campaign recipe
the source does not justify copying any referenced game's visual identity
marketplace importance does not by itself prove conversion or long-term attachment
reuse_note: Only the abstract concept of a coordinated but format-adaptive visual signature informed this matrix; no game, campaign, logo, creator style, slide image, or source wording is reused.

mechanisms.statement: declare a small campaign visual-signature constellation before producing individual assets
separate invariant identity rules from the functional role of each key art capsule banner card and event asset
preserve one focal motif and value hierarchy across crops while recomposing secondary detail for each aspect ratio
keep the evergreen identity layer distinct from a temporary event or update layer
use an artwork-first core and add only format-authorized localized text or logos in dedicated zones
coordinate color iconographic shapes marks and edge treatment as a system rather than repeating one poster
test campaign variants by changing one meaningful visual hypothesis at a time
review the asset family together so continuity and deliberate variation are both visible

illustration_evidence_definitions.campaign_signature_constellation: At least three campaign assets visibly share the same declared combination of original motif, value hierarchy, graphic mark rhythm, and edge treatment without duplicating one composition.
illustration_evidence_definitions.campaign_asset_role_board: A board labels the function, aspect ratio, focal priority, text allowance, and expiration status of each asset before illustration begins.
illustration_evidence_definitions.campaign_focal_motif_crop_set: Square, vertical, and horizontal crops retain one original focal motif and primary value grouping while secondary elements are deliberately recomposed.
illustration_evidence_definitions.campaign_core_event_layer_pair: An evergreen base and a time-bounded event variant visibly share the core identity while the event layer adds only the declared temporary delta.
illustration_evidence_definitions.campaign_logo_artwork_separation: Artwork-only, transparent logo, and combined versions exist as separate deliverables so each placement can obey its own content rules.
illustration_evidence_definitions.campaign_localized_text_zone: A reserved zone accommodates approved localized copy without covering the focal character, action, or identity motif.
illustration_evidence_definitions.campaign_single_variable_variant: Two test variants differ in exactly one declared campaign hypothesis such as focal motif, crop, or color emphasis while other conditions remain fixed.
illustration_evidence_definitions.campaign_family_contact_sheet: All approved assets appear at representative display sizes on one sheet, making both continuity and role-specific differences directly inspectable.

localize permitted copy while retaining an artwork-only identity core

do not infer campaign success from internal visual consistency alone
counterexamples: a banner square card and vertical cover made only by cropping the same face at different edges
a seasonal asset whose colors symbols and subject are unrelated to the evergreen campaign

title: Steamworks Graphical Asset Rules
abstracted_dimensions: store and library assets have distinct artwork logo and text allowances
base capsule art is separated from temporary artwork overrides for major updates or events
temporary promotional text must be localized to supported languages
library capsule hero and logo files serve different functions and content constraints
limitations: the rules govern one storefront and may change
compliance does not establish artistic quality or campaign effectiveness
content restrictions cannot be transferred unchanged to unrelated platforms
the documentation supplies no general viewer-preference model
reuse_note: Only asset-role, text-layer, localization, and evergreen-versus-temporary constraints were abstracted; no store capsule, game art, logo, template image, or promotional copy is reused.

title: App Store Product Page Optimization
abstracted_dimensions: icons screenshots and preview videos can be compared against an original product page
up to three alternate product-page treatments may be tested
engagement is evaluated through platform analytics rather than assumed from visual preference
the winning tested treatment can be applied after the comparison
supported_dimensions: measured engagement instead of aesthetic intuition
limitations: the source concerns app product pages and not every subculture campaign format
platform analytics do not explain why viewers preferred an asset
observed engagement is conditional on audience placement and test period
the workflow does not justify post hoc changes to success criteria
reuse_note: Only the bounded original-versus-variant measurement workflow informed the matrix; no app icon screenshot video campaign result brand identity or sample metric is reused.

title: The Framing of Subjectivity: Point-of-View in a Cross-Cultural Analysis of Comics
abstracted_dimensions: the study compares point-of-view and focal framing patterns in an annotated corpus containing comics from China Japan Korea Europe and the United States
formal frequencies vary across comic traditions and also overlap across them
close focal and amorphic environmental framing are associated with subjective panels across the corpus
the findings concern sampled visual-language structures and do not define national personality or universal viewer meaning
limitations: the corpus uses convenience sampling and does not represent every creator genre period platform or reader
production frequency is not direct evidence of how a particular audience interprets a convention
country labels in the corpus cannot be converted into fixed ethnic psychological or market traits
the study does not provide a controlled three-way CJK reader-comprehension comparison
reuse_note: Only the existence of context-bounded formal variation and overlap informed the matrix; no comic panel, title, character, creator signature, national stereotype, or source wording is reused.

mechanisms.statement: record reader familiarity genre exposure language and interface separately from region labels
treat a convention's corpus frequency as context evidence rather than universal semantic equivalence
separate how a work is formally constructed from how a viewer actually attends to or interprets it
pair an unfamiliar symbolic cue with literal action object state or consequence when comprehension matters
store page scroll reading-direction and interface assumptions as format metadata rather than country defaults
preserve a clear reading path while allowing format-native focal and background strategies
offer an optional redundancy level for unfamiliar readers without labeling an audience deficient
require locale and audience review for text-image interaction instead of translating every CJK convention one-to-one

illustration_evidence_definitions.cjk_reading_path_anchor: The first focal entry and intended continuation are visible through panel placement, gaze, motion, contrast, or spacing without relying on a country label.
illustration_evidence_definitions.cjk_panel_sequence_disambiguation: An otherwise ambiguous sequence includes a nonverbal ordering cue or layout break that makes the next panel identifiable in the declared reading format.
illustration_evidence_definitions.cjk_symbol_literal_action_pair: A symbolic mark is accompanied by an observable gesture, object state, or consequence so meaning does not depend on knowing the symbol alone.
illustration_evidence_definitions.cjk_format_native_spacing: Panel and gutter or scroll spacing is composed for the declared page or interface format and verified there rather than inferred from nationality.
illustration_evidence_definitions.cjk_text_image_reference_alignment: Balloon, caption, or sound-effect placement points unambiguously to the relevant speaker, action, object, or panel in the target language layout.
illustration_evidence_definitions.cjk_subjective_viewpoint_context: A subjective view includes enough prior or adjacent spatial evidence to identify whose perception it represents and what has become focal.
illustration_evidence_definitions.cjk_background_focal_balance: Background information and focal subject are deliberately weighted for the scene purpose, with neither balance attributed to a national cognitive trait.
illustration_evidence_definitions.cjk_unfamiliar_reader_fallback: A second rendering or composition adds one literal action, spatial, or sequencing cue while leaving the core scene and audience dignity intact.

title: Understanding the Reader Demographics of an Emerging Online Reading Platform, Webtoon
abstracted_dimensions: the study analyzes 1117 valid adult reader survey responses for a born-digital webtoon platform
reader profiles differ across motivations and appeal elements rather than forming one audience type
visual style sound interactivity time commitment user-friendliness and price appear among platform-specific appeals
the work frames reader understanding as useful for recommendation rather than as a national essence
supported_dimensions: audience persona as measured grouping rather than nationality
visual and interface factors in media use
limitations: the sample is a platform reader survey and not a controlled test of individual visual conventions

title: The Cross-Cultural Interplay of Visual Attention and Artistic Design in Comics

objective and subjective viewpoint designs interact differently with focal-object and background attention

limitations: the study compares two participant backgrounds and cannot stand for China Korea or every Japanese reader

title: What Can I Protect with a Copyright?
abstracted_dimensions: copyright originality is described in relation to independently created expression rather than an underlying idea
ideas concepts methods procedures and systems are distinguished from the particular expression embodying them
protection and formal requirements can vary by country
the high-level distinction does not itself decide whether a particular remix is permitted
limitations: the page is general international information and not legal advice
idea-expression distinctions are difficult in concrete cases and vary across jurisdictions
the source does not grant permission to imitate a living creator's style or a protected character design
no fair-use public-domain trademark publicity or contract conclusion can be drawn from this summary
reuse_note: Only the high-level separation of abstract mechanism from particular expression informed a conservative originality workflow; no work, character, creator style, legal conclusion, or source wording is reused.

mechanisms.statement: record source ownership license permission or public-domain basis before using any reference asset
decompose a reference into generic mechanisms such as focal hierarchy edge rhythm material contrast and narrative timing
exclude protected names logos signature silhouettes costume-prop constellations catchphrases and scene-specific arrangements from runtime candidates
replace creator-name style requests with self-authored mark edge omission palette and distortion rules
require a new original subject silhouette object relationship setting and causal event after abstraction
keep a transformation ledger that states which generic mechanisms were retained and which source-specific expressions were rejected
route recognizable character or artwork adaptation to authorization review or an original alternative without making a legal determination
retain tamper-evident provenance metadata or a local source ledger when the production pipeline supports it

candidate_definitions.protected_marker_exclusion: A guard excluding protected or rights-sensitive names logos emblems catchphrases signature silhouettes costume-prop constellations and scene-specific arrangements.
candidate_definitions.style_non_imitation: A default guard that replaces creator-name imitation with an original self-declared visual grammar.
candidate_definitions.original_combination_requirement: A requirement for a new subject silhouette object relationship setting action and causal consequence after mechanism abstraction.
candidate_definitions.authorization_or_original_route: A router that sends recognizable adaptation requests to documented authorization review or to an original alternative without deciding legality.
candidate_definitions.content_credentials_optional: An optional provenance output using a supported content-credential manifest or a local ledger while never implying rights clearance.

cite source names in research evidence while keeping runtime candidates and generated prompts name-free
conflicts: do not combine a protected name with a recognizable silhouette costume prop and signature scene while claiming abstraction

title: Copyright Law of the United States, Chapter 1
abstracted_dimensions: the statute distinguishes ideas procedures processes systems methods concepts principles and discoveries from protected expression
a derivative work includes forms in which a preexisting work is recast transformed or adapted
protection in a derivative work is limited to newly contributed material and does not enlarge rights in preexisting material
the copyright owner has an exclusive right to authorize preparation of derivative works subject to statutory limitations
supported_dimensions: idea versus expression distinction in United States law
limitations: the source is United States law and cannot decide another jurisdiction's rules
the statutory text cannot determine a fact-specific dispute without legal analysis
this packet does not evaluate statutory exceptions fair use ownership or enforceability
the source does not define a universal visual distance threshold
reuse_note: Only high-level statutory distinctions informed a conservative routing guard; no legal conclusion is made and no protected work, character, design, or source wording is reused.

title: Understanding C2PA Manifests
abstracted_dimensions: a manifest can record provenance information for an asset
successive creation or editing actions can add manifests to a manifest store
the active manifest contains bindings that can be validated against the asset
manifest stores may be embedded sidecar-based or remotely referenced
supported_dimensions: embedded sidecar and remote manifest placement
limitations: C2PA records asserted provenance and does not determine copyright ownership permission or fair use
a valid signature establishes technical integrity within the trust model rather than truth of every underlying rights claim
toolchain and platform support varies
sensitive information must not be placed in a public manifest or ledger
reuse_note: Only the technical distinction between recorded provenance and rights clearance informed the matrix; no credential key manifest identity sample asset or source wording is reused.
